products.name: Tuga A6
products.tagline: The one that lives in your pocket.
products.shortFor: Barcode scanning, photos, job sheets and sign-off, on a handheld that survives the site.
products.description: A 6 inch rugged Android 15 handheld with a built-in 2D barcode scanner. IP67 sealed, rated for 1.5 metre drops, with 4G, NFC and a removable 5050mAh battery.
products.longDescription: The A6 is the smallest device in the range. At 277g it goes in a pocket or a belt holster, and the 2D barcode scanner in the top edge means proof of delivery, stock checks and asset tags need no second device. Two side scan keys work with gloves on. It is sealed to IP67 and rated for 1.5 metre drops, runs Android 15, and the 5050mAh battery is removable, so a charged spare can take over mid shift. 4G with dual SIM, dual-band Wi-Fi and NFC are on board, and GPS, GLONASS, BeiDou and Galileo for location.
highlights: Built-in 2D barcode scanner with two side scan keys
277g and 6 inches, so it lives in a pocket or holster
Removable 5050mAh battery, so a spare keeps you going
IP67 sealed and rated for 1.5 metre drops

specs.cpu: MediaTek Helio P35 octa-core, up to 2.3GHz
specs.ports: USB-C, dual Nano-SIM (or Nano-SIM + microSD), charging contacts

products.positioning: The pocket option. Barcode scanning, proof of delivery, quick photos, comms.

products.name: Tuga A8
products.tagline: The all-rounder. Fits the van door pocket.
products.shortFor: Forms, maps, site photos and quotes, readable in full sun.
products.description: An 8 inch rugged Android tablet with a 1000 nit screen, IP67 sealing, 4G with dual SIM and a removable 8000mAh battery. VESA mount points mean it docks in the van as well as working on site.
products.metaDescription: 8 inch rugged Android tablet with a 1000 nit screen, IP67 sealing, dual SIM 4G and a removable 8000mAh battery. VESA mounts dock it in the van.
products.longDescription: Eight inches is the middle of the three sizes. It is big enough to fill in a form, read a drawing or follow a route without pinching and zooming, and small enough to hold in one hand up a ladder or drop into a van door pocket. The 1000 nit screen stays readable in direct sun, and the housing is sealed to IP67. The 8000mAh battery is removable, so a charged spare can take over on a long day. VESA mount points and pogo pin contacts on the back mean it locks into a vehicle dock on the road and comes out as a site tablet when you get there. 4G with dual SIM, NFC and GPS, GLONASS, Galileo and BeiDou are built in.
highlights: 1000 nit screen you can read on a bright roof
Removable 8000mAh battery, so a spare doubles your shift
VESA mount points, so it is a dashboard unit and site tablet in one
Dual SIM 4G for patchy rural coverage

specs.cpu: MediaTek Helio P35 octa-core, up to 2.3GHz
specs.ports: USB-C, DC in, dual SIM, microSD, pogo pin

products.positioning: The all-rounder. The sweet spot between portability and screen space.

products.name: Tuga A10
products.tagline: Full-size. For drawings you actually need to read.
products.shortFor: Blueprints, BIM viewers, full spreadsheets and PDF plans.
products.description: A 10.1 inch Full HD rugged Android tablet for when you need real screen space. IP68 sealed and MIL-STD-810H tested, with 8GB RAM, an 8000mAh battery, NFC and dual SIM 4G in a slim 680g body.
products.metaDescription: 10.1 inch Full HD rugged Android tablet. IP68 sealed, MIL-STD-810H tested, 8GB RAM, 8000mAh battery, NFC and dual SIM 4G in a 680g body.
products.longDescription: When the job involves drawings, the 8 inch stops being enough. The A10 gives you a full 10.1 inch Full HD screen for blueprints, BIM viewers, spreadsheets and PDF plans, in a slim 14.5mm body sealed to IP68 and tested to MIL-STD-810H. The 8000mAh battery has quick charge, and dual SIM 4G keeps you connected across networks on rural and remote sites. This is the one that lives in a vehicle mount or a site office and gets picked up all day.
highlights: 10.1 inch Full HD screen, so you can read a drawing without pinching and zooming
IP68 and MIL-STD-810H in a slim 14.5mm, 680g body
8GB RAM and 128GB storage, expandable to 2TB
Dual SIM 4G for patchy rural coverage

specs.connectivity: 4G Dual SIM, dual-band Wi-Fi 5, Bluetooth 5.2, NFC

products.positioning: The site tablet. Blueprints, BIM viewers, full spreadsheets, PDF plans.

products.name: Tuga WH6
products.shortFor: Legacy Windows software and network drives, in a holster.
products.description: A 6.5 inch rugged Windows 11 handheld for professionals who need desktop software on the move. Run legacy apps, access network drives, and manage field data from a device that fits in a holster.
products.metaDescription: 6.5 inch rugged Windows 11 handheld for desktop software on the move. Run legacy apps, reach network drives, and carry it in a holster.
products.longDescription: The WH6 puts full Windows 11 in your pocket. An Intel Celeron N5100, 8GB of RAM and 128GB of storage (plus a microSD slot for more) run the Windows software your industry never moved off, reach network drives, and manage field data without compromise. It is rated IP65 and MIL-STD-810H, survives 1.5 metre drops, and works from -20°C to 60°C. The 4000mAh battery is removable, so a spare keeps you going through a long shift, and 4G LTE, GPS + GLONASS and NFC are on board. USB-A and USB-C ports connect straight to instruments and peripherals. A 2D barcode scanner is available as an option for warehouse and logistics work, and a charging dock is sold separately for desk use.
highlights: Full Windows 11, not a mobile OS pretending
Intel Celeron N5100, 8GB RAM, 128GB storage
Removable 4000mAh battery, so a spare keeps you running
Fits a holster, runs desktop software
Optional integrated 2D barcode scanner

specs.charging: USB-C PD fast charge, pogo pin for dock
specs.connectivity: 4G LTE, dual-band Wi-Fi 5, Bluetooth 5.0, NFC, GPS + GLONASS
specs.ports: USB-C (OTG), USB-A, microSD, Nano-SIM, pogo pin

products.positioning: Windows in your pocket for professionals who need desktop software on the move.

products.name: Tuga W8
products.shortFor: Windows software in the field, with real ports.
products.description: An 8 inch rugged Windows 11 Pro tablet with an Intel processor, full USB ports and HDMI output. For professionals who need Windows software in the field without giving up durability.
products.metaDescription: 8 inch rugged Windows 11 Pro tablet with an Intel processor, full USB ports and HDMI out. Desktop software in the field without giving up durability.
products.longDescription: The W8 puts full Windows 11 Pro in a rugged 8 inch body. An Intel Celeron N5100, 8GB of RAM and a 128GB SSD run your Windows software as they would on a desk. The 1920 x 1200 screen gives you room for a full page, and the port selection is the point: USB-C, USB-A and Mini HDMI, so you can connect to whatever the job needs rather than carrying a bag of adapters. Sealed to IP65 and tested to MIL-STD-810G with 1.22 metre drops, with a removable 5000mAh battery and a pogo pin dock connector for desk mounting. NFC is built in, and a barcode scanner variant is available.
highlights: Full Windows 11 Pro in an 8 inch rugged body
1920 x 1200 screen, USB-C, USB-A and Mini HDMI, so no adapter bag
Removable 5000mAh battery and a pogo pin dock connector
Optional integrated 2D barcode scanner

specs.ports: USB-C 3.1, USB-A 3.0, Mini HDMI 2.0a, 3.5mm audio, SIM/TF tray, pogo pin

products.positioning: The 8 inch Windows tablet for professionals who need real software in the field.

products.name: Tuga W10
products.shortFor: Engineers and surveyors who need Ethernet, HDMI and a full screen.
products.description: A 10.1 inch rugged Windows 11 Pro tablet with an Intel N100 processor and a full port selection including RJ45 Ethernet and HDMI. For engineers, surveyors and field professionals who need full desktop capability.
products.metaDescription: 10.1 inch rugged Windows 11 Pro tablet with an Intel N100, RJ45 Ethernet and HDMI. For engineers and surveyors who need full desktop capability.
products.longDescription: The W10 is the full desktop experience in a rugged package. An Intel N100 processor (up to 3.4GHz), 8GB of RAM and 128GB of storage run Windows 11 Pro on a 10.1 inch IPS touchscreen. The port selection is what sets it apart: HDMI, RJ45 Ethernet, USB-C and USB-A for direct connections to plant, panels and network gear that has never seen Wi-Fi. Rated IP65 for dust and water jets, with a removable 5000mAh battery, NFC, a microSD slot and a pogo pin dock connector. Options include 4G LTE, GPS, a fingerprint reader, a 2D barcode scanner and a UHF RFID reader.
highlights: RJ45 Ethernet, so you can plug straight into panels and plant
10.1 inch IPS touchscreen, full Windows 11 Pro on an Intel N100
Removable 5000mAh battery, USB-C, USB-A, HDMI and Ethernet on board
Optional 2D barcode scanner and UHF RFID reader

specs.connectivity: Dual-band Wi-Fi 5, Bluetooth 5.2, NFC, 100Mbps Ethernet, optional 4G LTE

products.positioning: The full desktop experience. Real screen estate, full ports, full Windows.
